# DexBuilder Developer Docs

> DexBuilder provides perpetual trading and Builder infrastructure for traders, applications, wallets, brokers, exchanges, and branded DEX projects.

## Start here

- Overview: /index
- Choose an integration path: /getting-started/choose-a-path
- Trader quickstart: /getting-started/trader-quickstart
- Builder quickstart: /getting-started/builder-quickstart
- Integration checklist: /getting-started/integration-checklist

## Core flows

- Authentication: /authentication/overview
- Place an order: /trading/place-first-order
- Funds overview: /funds/overview
- Transaction Builder: /funds/transaction-builder
- Configure Builder fees: /builders/configure-fees
- Revenue and payouts: /builders/revenue-and-payouts

## API specifications

- Confirmed Aden-compatible Trading API: /openapi/trading-v1.yaml
- Proposed Builder API: /openapi/builder-preview.yaml

## 中文文档

- 文档首页：/zh/index
- 选择接入路径：/zh/getting-started/choose-a-path
- 交易 API 快速开始：/zh/getting-started/trader-quickstart
- Builder 快速开始：/zh/getting-started/builder-quickstart
- API 覆盖范围与发布状态：/zh/resources/api-coverage
- 中文交易 API：/openapi/zh/trading-v1.yaml
- 中文 Builder API：/openapi/zh/builder-preview.yaml

Builder and Funds endpoints marked Preview must not be represented as production-available until DexBuilder publishes a base URL and release note.
